description: Structured Bazel cherry-pick pull request review output.

should_post.description: Whether to post this review to GitHub (false to skip duplicate automatic follow-up reviews).

skip_reason.description: Concise explanation when should_post is false; empty string when should_post is true.

comments.description: Inline diff review comments (at most 6 items, only on added or removed diff lines).

path.description: Repository-relative file path in the PR diff.

line.description: 1-based line number on the specified diff side.

side.description: Diff side: RIGHT for added (+) lines, LEFT for removed (-) lines.

start_line.description: Optional starting line number for a multi-line comment range (start_line < line).

body.description: Markdown inline comment starting with severity emoji (🔴, 🟠, or 🟡).
